claims.claim: Eleven workflows exist in .github/workflows
ci.yml triggers on push and pull_request to main with paths-ignore list
ci.yml jobs: test, sonarcloud, integration-tests, lint, build, weak-assertions, perf-regression
test job runs gotestsum -race with coverage over runtime, sdk, pkg, server/a2a and sdk/integration
test job merges profiles into coverage.out and rewrites paths
test job vets and tests nested example modules
test job publishes Test Results and uploads coverage-report for 5 days
integration-tests runs ./sdk/integration/... with -race -count=1
lint uses golangci-lint v2.14.0 across four modules, skipped for dependabot
sonarcloud needs test and lint, skipped for dependabot, uses SONAR_TOKEN
build runs make build and four guard scripts
weak-assertions runs on pull requests only against the base sha
perf-regression builds base revision on the same runner and interleaves runs
fails when head median under 85% of base or under 600 rps; fallback floor 1300
500 concurrent clients and 5000 requests, 2 rounds
RSS ceiling 512 MB, CPU ceiling 150% (plain), 175% (event store), floor 1100 with event store
event-store run fails on lost events, <90% started, >=2000 goroutines
dependabot-gate job is named SonarCloud Analysis and runs when branch starts with dependabot/
cla.yml CLAAssistant stores signatures in AltairaLabs/cla-signatures, allowlists bots, recheck comment
docs.yml triggers: release published, pull_request on paths, workflow_dispatch
docs.yml build steps (node 22, go, gomarkdoc, D2, docs-install, mermaid, docs-build, link checks, upload)
deploy runs unless pull request; pages concurrency group does not cancel
docs-checks runs docs script tests, voice check, stale report on every PR
docs-freshness weekly Monday 07:00 UTC, issue label docs-freshness
reference-drift runs make docs-reference-check and docs-sdk-reference-check
schemas.yml jobs and commands; promptpack check only on push/PR
promptpack-schema-sync opens chore/promptpack-schema-v<version> PR and never merges
mcp-conformance jobs spec-parity, mirror, official-suite and their commands
release.yml inputs version, phase (full, libs-only, tools-only), skip_tests, ignore_previous_release_check
validate: version format, newer than latest runtime tag, previous go.mod check, tests, dep skew, standalone, API compat
tag-dependencies tags root and runtime from main, pkg from release/libs branch with replace dropped, verifies go proxy
update-tools tags server/a2a and sdk from release/tools branch, drops replaces
create-release draft release, SPDX SBOM, attestation
verify-docs publishes release using HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN and waits for docs.yml run
notify-downstream waits for Go proxy then dispatches promptkit-release to four adapter repos with DOWNSTREAM_DISPATCH_TOKEN
summary runs always and prints go get commands
secrets: SONAR_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN, DOWNSTREAM_DISPATCH_TOKEN
scripts check-no-audio-device-leak imports purego for runtime/providers/base, pkg/config, sdk
make lint checks golangci-lint version via check-lint-version.sh
Previously claimed: Jekyll build, Ruby 3.1, deploy on push to main, only-new-issues, Go 1.25.1, dorny v1.9.1
